answer.reason: The marked verses give several shared deeds of the women at the burial and the tomb, which can be told without choosing between the Marys.

clauses.english: saw where Jesus was laid in the sepulchre
bought sweet spices and came to the sepulchre to anoint Jesus
clauses.quote: had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him

doubts: The marked verses mix Mary Magdalene with Mary the mother of James and Joses, so it is unclear which Mary this record is. I kept only deeds both share.
I left out the deeds of Mary Magdalene alone (seven devils cast out, meeting the risen Jesus in the garden, telling the disciples) because they may belong to another record.
JHN 19:25 and JHN 20 name a Mary who may be someone else of the same name, so I did not use them.
